before.text: The release supplies a hardened TLS/OIDC template, migrations, locks, provenance, operations documentation, video and portfolio case study. A real IdP, hosted backend, production-container execution, paid provider, merchant connector and human claim-support study remain external validation work. A future remote connector needs provider idempotency and explicit unknown-outcome/reconciliation; local database atomicity cannot guarantee a remote effect.

after.text: The [live workbench](https://resolvelab-blush.vercel.app) runs its FastAPI backend and private evaluation consumer on Vercel, with restricted Neon PostgreSQL roles, separate serving/evaluation databases and Neon Managed Better Auth. Production fixture login is disabled. A verified provider identity must be explicitly mapped to a server-maintained membership and customer context; public signup alone grants no workspace access. The retailer, orders and policies remain synthetic portfolio data. See [production scope and evidence](PRODUCTION.md) for configuration, enrollment and operating limits.
